items.why: Guess captures the floating black stone mountain and the fear.
Waiting in dread matches, but 'sky to fall' makes the viewer expect the fortress to fall, which the narration never says.
Floating fortress Moonspawn guarding Pale is read exactly.
Mage battling a tall pale man with fire magic matches the Tattersail versus Rake clash.
Joining powers while afraid matches pooling power against annihilation.
Fortress drifting south is stated directly.
